newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Hipotecario launches mortgage bonds.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Hipotecario launches mortgage bonds.

text.p: Argentina's Banco Hipotecario Nacional announced Monday the launching of its mortgage-backed peso bonds in the local market.

The mortgage bank which is soon to be privatized said it aims to place between 50 million and 70 million pesos of this first series of mortgage-backed bonds with local investors before the end of this month.
The portfolio of loans that will be securitized is made up of 20,723 loans amounting to 212 million pesos.
Banco Hipotecario said the issues are aimed at the local private pension funds.

The organizers of the issue are Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and C.J. Lawrence Inc, while the underwriters are Banco Frances del Rio de la Plata, Banco de Galicia y Buenos Aires, Banco Hipotecario Nacional, Banco Rio de la Plata, Banco Roberts, Banco Tornquist and Deutshce Morgan Grenfell.
